annotations.title: Employer cost of a salary in France

description: What a salary in France costs the employer (employer social contributions itemised), or the reverse: the gross salary a total budget allows. Give gross_annual or budget_annual.

budget_annual.description: Total yearly employer budget in EUR, to find the gross salary it allows

impat.description: Impatriate regime (recruited from abroad). Flat 30% of pay exempt from income tax for up to 8 years. Default false.

isolated.description: Raising children alone (parent isolé). Unmarried with children living with you: one extra half-part. Default true.

married.description: Married or registered partner. Default false.

spouse_income.description: Partner's gross yearly income in EUR, for joint taxation and spouse allowances. Default 0.

tax_year.description: Tax year. Offered: 2026 (final), 2025 (final), 2024 (final). Default 2026. A year that is not listed is not available for this country.
